title: Commercial roll values in Loving County, TX, 2022 to 2024: what the appraisal district's files show
description: Computed figures from the appraisal district's roll files for Loving County, TX: stated values of commercial, industrial and multifamily parcels by roll year, 2022 to 2024, and how many parcels' values rose or fell.

sentences.text: The current file lists 26 parcels in the commercial scope (multifamily, commercial and industrial real property).
In 2022, 26 of them have a stated market value, totalling $50,235,000.
In 2023, 26 of them have a stated market value, totalling $54,561,000.
In 2024, 26 of them have a stated market value, totalling $57,938,640.
Of 26 parcels with a value in both 2022 and 2023, 15 (57.7%) were higher in 2023 than in 2022, 0 (0.0%) were lower and 11 were unchanged.
Between 2022 and 2023, 3 parcels rose by more than 10 percent and 0 fell by more than 10 percent.
Between 2022 and 2023, 0 parcels rose by more than 25 percent and 0 fell by more than 25 percent.
The median change in stated value between 2022 and 2023 was 10.0 percent; the lower quartile was 0.0 percent and the upper quartile was 10.0 percent.
Of 26 parcels with a value in both 2023 and 2024, 14 (53.8%) were higher in 2024 than in 2023, 9 (34.6%) were lower and 3 were unchanged.
Between 2023 and 2024, 11 parcels rose by more than 10 percent and 3 fell by more than 10 percent.
Between 2023 and 2024, 11 parcels rose by more than 25 percent and 0 fell by more than 25 percent.
The median change in stated value between 2023 and 2024 was 3.0 percent; the lower quartile was -5.0 percent and the upper quartile was 30.0 percent.
Of 26 parcels with a value in both 2022 and 2024, 23 (88.5%) were higher in 2024 than in 2022, 0 (0.0%) were lower and 3 were unchanged.
Between 2022 and 2024, 14 parcels rose by more than 10 percent and 0 fell by more than 10 percent.
Between 2022 and 2024, 11 parcels rose by more than 25 percent and 0 fell by more than 25 percent.
The median change in stated value between 2022 and 2024 was 13.3 percent; the lower quartile was 4.5 percent and the upper quartile was 30.0 percent.

In the current file, 25 of 26 parcels (96.2%) have an organisation as owner of record, and 21 (80.8%) are owned of record by an organisation matched by exact normalized name to the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts active franchise taxpayer file.
